g.text: circuitRF includes none of these programs. It can install each from its own upstream (Install … below), or you can install them
yourself and check each row. Leave a path blank to search for it.
Leave blank to search (CIRCUITRF_PALACE, PATH, then Spack)
Not found: nothing named palace installed by circuitRF, on PATH, in the default directories, in a Spack installation or in a conda
A default Palace build includes ParMETIS, whose licence allows commercial use for evaluation only. If you build Palace, you accept
MPI launcher (runs Palace on several cores)
Leave blank to search (CIRCUITRF_MPIRUN, Palace's own MPI, then PATH)
Not found: no MPI launcher (mpirun) was found in Settings, CIRCUITRF_MPIRUN, beside Palace, in Palace's Spack installation, on
PATH or in the default directories. Palace will run on one core.
